title: A singular normal affine surface with free tangent sheaf
main_claim: There is a finitely generated normal integral C-algebra A of dimension 2 with Der_C(A) ≅ A^2 and a non-regular maximal localization A_m. This would be a counterexample to the Lipman–Zariski conjecture in characteristic zero. The construction is an analytic germ that contracts a genus-21 curve C with C^2=-10 and discrepancy -5, and it has p_g≥33. Its two vector fields come from glued finite jets whose determinant is t^5(1+O(t)). The germ is then algebraized by finite determinacy with a relation matrix plus Artin approximation.
coverage:
I read all six sections in full and checked them as follows.
- §2 numerics, rechecked by hand: bidegrees; the bundle identities on Γ; g(C)=21; deg H=4; deg L=10; 4L=K_C; the restriction-kernel cohomology on P^1×P^1; the evaluation-rank table; the dimension formula; h^0 values; evaluation surjectivity for (k+1)L, k≥2; h^1(L)=12. The six-vector lemma algebra was also checked: d^2 + d·(h,h) = 1, Vieta, and w^2=90.
- §3: splitting type (3,0,0,-3) and dim W=2; the dual-evaluation square E/s; the local principal-part comparison, including s(0) = -b1^4/K0^2 and α^2·E/s = -E_Γ, which gives the isometry with sign; the ν residue argument giving <J,T> = -V(T); the identities R∧p=-1 and Σ(W_j-1) = -90.
- §4, verified with sympy: the general bracket formula; the order-1 second-exponential contributions (ΔA_2, ΔU); the Laurent residues F, H and the matrix T_ij; and the sym/alt decomposition. By hand: the Ψ transformation law (3/4)ε dlog g; the outside total -(3/4)ε·deg L from the residue theorem with the 4+6 logarithmic poles; the inside alt total (1/12)·Σ(W-1) = -7.5, which matches; the sym total vanishing via Res(P_iP_j); the σ-preservation choices b = m'/3, h'/2, h'; the order-3 λ/z correction residue 3λr'(0); the k≥4 vanishings; and the target transport at k=4 (exact differential dh).
- §5: the I^9F threshold (H^1(L^n) and H^1(L^{n-4}) vanish for n≥9); the formal-functions/pro-zero argument; Hartogs extension to a frame; non-smoothness via K_Y·C=50; the p_g≥33 bound.
- §6: the constants in the finite-determinacy lemma (the q≥N, 2q≥n+1 estimates and the Artin–Rees steps); the Artin approximation setup; flat descent of freeness, normality and the Fitting ideal.
Not done: an independent check that the cited positive results (Graf, Bergner–Graf, Biswas–Gurjar–Kolte) are quoted with their exact hypotheses, and a re-derivation of the higher-order (k=4..7) bookkeeping beyond its logical structure.
